user.title: Teams Status Randomiser
user.description: Enter the address of the PC running the app. Turn the bridge on first in the app: Settings → Behaviour → System. To reach it from another machine you also need "Allow other machines on my network to connect" and the firewall rule the app offers when you save.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the PC running the app.
data_description.port: The bridge port from the app's settings (8757 by default).
data_description.token: The access token from the app's settings. Required when the LAN option is on.

reconfigure.title: Teams Status Randomiser
reconfigure.description: Update the address or token — for example after regenerating the token, or if the PC's IP address changed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the app. Check it is running, the bridge is enabled, and the port and firewall allow this machine.
error.invalid_auth: The app rejected that token. Copy it again from Settings → Behaviour → System.

abort.already_configured: That bridge is already set up.
